name: Heusenstamm (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and green with a broad white middle stripe, charged at the centre with the city arms of Heusenstamm (green oak leaves on white under a red chief).
history: The flags were approved for the municipality by the Hessian Minister of the Interior on 6 May 1959.

features.role: Heusenstamm arms — oak leaves on white
